comments:
bca39a19: ;
Initialization of variables used in calculating report turnaround times.
IFN is the visit file (#393) internal entry number.
DGJTPAR will store the processing timelimits from file (#40.8) pertaining to IFN.
3c833e84: Builds the DGJTPAR parameter string from file #40.8 to contain timelimits for dictation, transcription and signature.
fef34871: Gets date/time data if present for current visit in file #393.
caab9f97: Computes current date/time and initializes a delay days counter.
6c7ccfec: Checks if current visit status matches that in the 11th node of file #393. If so, sets a flag DGJTREC and calls a PROC routine.
f4baee1d: End of initialization. Returns control.
20b4aa95: DICTATED: Checks from date/time dictation was completed, sets flags/delay accordingly and computes totals.
4d735e7f: TRANSCRIBED: Checks from date/time transcription was completed against site parameter timeframe, sets flags/delay accordingly and computes totals.
052ce069: SIGNED: Checks from date/time signature was completed against site parameter timeframe, sets flags/delay accordingly and computes totals.
96626cb7: ;Quit if no transcription or release date.
a53db662: ;Calculates days late.
d1ecaa78: ;Calculates total days for dictated, printed & completed. DGJTFLLG flag set if no provider code.
93dfb691: ;Set dashes for transcription & printed if no dictation date.
71f6de36: ;Accumulate days for dictation.
a694080a: ;Accumulate days for transcription and set the printed figure with a *.
f5f43f20: ;If transcribed, get provider code.
ee1e7fd5: ;If transcribed, calculate total time to complete and set the completed figure.
fb4b18dc: ;Quit.
db7bbb90: ;Look up provider code, set DGJTFLLG flag if not found.
90d2190a: ;If the provider's code does not map to a valid coding system, set the flag to indicate that data is missing.
5a8d5039: ;Quit the COD procedure.
294e4a1b: ;Set the appropriate counters and output variables for the dictated, transcribed, and completed times, taking into account whether data is missing or not.
